name: Tensor Times Matrix (TTM) Reconstruction
definition: A GPU-based volume reconstruction method that sequentially applies three Tensor Times Matrix (TTM) kernels to reconstruct a volume brick from a core tensor and factor matrices, reducing computational complexity to linear growth with rank R.
summary: Tensor Times Matrix Reconstruction is a GPU-based volume rendering method that sequentially applies three kernels to reconstruct volume bricks from compressed tensors, reducing computational complexity to linear growth with rank.
